market_notes: German-speaking travellers plan thoroughly and search for legality before booking: whether their Internationaler Führerschein covers motorbikes, whether Auslandskranken- and Haftpflichtversicherung pay after a Rollerunfall, and what a Kaution involves. 'Roller' dominates everyday vocabulary; 'Motorrad' appears in licence and touring queries.

proposals.working_title: Halbautomatik-Motorrad fahren: Schalten ohne Kupplung erklärt
proposals.intent_rationale: Visitors who have only ridden automatic scooters search for how to operate a clutchless semi-automatic before choosing one; how-to intent, distinct from the manual-versus-automatic choice guide.

proposals.working_title: 110, 125 oder 150 cm³: Welcher Hubraum passt zu Stadt und Bergen?
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders planning mountain routes compare engine capacity and ask what their licence class permits; complements the 50cc/electric guide, which covers the low-power end.

proposals.primary_query: honda wave oder honda vision mieten
proposals.working_title: Honda Wave, Vision und Air Blade: Mietroller-Typen im Vergleich
proposals.intent_rationale: Model names are how many renters actually search. Explaining the widely sold Honda families as vehicle types, with no availability claim, captures comparison intent the generic Hub cannot.

proposals.primary_query: roller zu zweit mit gepäck vietnam
proposals.working_title: Zu zweit mit Gepäck: das passende Zweirad wählen
proposals.intent_rationale: Couples and backpackers ask whether one bike can carry two people and luggage safely; a decision guide about load, seating and handling that no existing row answers.

proposals.working_title: Langzeitmiete in Hanoi: Was bei mehreren Monaten zu klären ist
proposals.intent_rationale: Residents, students and long-stay workers rent for months and need maintenance, paperwork and contract answers that a day/week/month price comparison does not cover.

proposals.working_title: Reisepass als Kaution hinterlegen: Risiken und Alternativen
proposals.intent_rationale: Leaving an identity document as security is a recurring traveller worry that official travel advice addresses; covers risks and questions to ask, never a provider's policy. The Auswärtiges Amt explicitly advises against leaving a passport as rental deposit.

proposals.working_title: Kosten neben der Miete: Benzin, Parken, Zustellung und Schäden
proposals.intent_rationale: People comparing quotes want to know which charges sit outside the rental fee; scoped to cost categories and questions to ask, never to amounts.

proposals.working_title: Tanken in Vietnam: RON 92 (E5) oder RON 95 für den Mietroller?
proposals.intent_rationale: First-time riders ask which petrol grade to buy and how stations work; practical, low-risk content that supports cost and breakdown-prevention questions.

proposals.working_title: Internationaler Führerschein für Motorräder in Vietnam
proposals.intent_rationale: Licence validity is the highest-stakes rental question. This guide is scoped to the international permit itself, separate from the home-licence guide, and must follow current official sources.

proposals.working_title: Schaden und Diebstahl: Haftungsklauseln im Mietvertrag
proposals.intent_rationale: Disputes over scratches, damage and theft are a major source of rental conflict; explains clauses to read and evidence to keep, without legal promises.
proposals.research_gap: Civil-law liability sources are not attached; drafting must cite the governing civil-code provisions or stay at questions-to-ask level.

proposals.working_title: Zahlt die Reiseversicherung bei einem Rollerunfall in Vietnam?
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders want to know what compulsory liability insurance covers and whether travel insurance pays after a crash; needs current decree references (67/2023 as amended by 220/2026) and policy-specific caveats. German searchers pair Auslandskrankenversicherung with licence class, so insurance and licence validity must be explained together.

secondary_queries: welche dokumente beim roller fahren vietnam
proposals.working_title: Welche Papiere beim Fahren dabei? Zulassungskarte (Blue Card) und mehr
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders ask which papers to carry if stopped, notably the vehicle registration card ('blue card'); distinct from the rental-documents Hub, which covers renting rather than riding.

proposals.working_title: Helm in Vietnam: Normen, Passform und eigener Helm
proposals.intent_rationale: Helmets are mandatory and the single biggest injury-prevention factor; readers ask about standards, fit and whether to bring their own.

proposals.working_title: Rollerfahren im Stadtverkehr von Hanoi: So funktioniert der Verkehrsfluss
proposals.intent_rationale: First-time riders need to understand Hanoi's traffic flow and core rules before riding; distinct from the rain and breakdown guides and from the general safety Hub.

proposals.working_title: Niedrigemissionszone im Hanoier Ring 1: Was Mieter von Zweirädern wissen sollten
proposals.intent_rationale: Hanoi announced a phased low-emission zone for Ring Road 1 starting with a 2026 pilot; renters need a sourced, date-checked explainer that does not overstate what is restricted.

proposals.working_title: Polizeikontrolle mit dem Mietroller: Was Sie erwartet
proposals.intent_rationale: Travellers worry about traffic police checks; covers documents to carry and the expected procedure, with no invented fine amounts.

proposals.working_title: Nach einem Rollerunfall in Vietnam: die ersten Schritte
proposals.intent_rationale: After a collision readers need immediate first steps and emergency contacts; distinct from the breakdown guide, which covers mechanical failure.

proposals.primary_query: ha giang loop motorrad mieten hanoi
proposals.working_title: Ha-Giang-Loop mit einem in Hanoi gemieteten Motorrad
proposals.intent_rationale: Many renters plan the Ha Giang Loop from Hanoi. Sits under the proposed routes Hub and stays ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKED until the owner approves that Hub.

proposals.working_title: Tagesausflug von Hanoi nach Ninh Binh mit dem Roller
proposals.intent_rationale: Day rides to Ninh Binh are a common first trip outside the city. Part of the proposed routes Hub and blocked until approval.

proposals.primary_query: schaltmotorrad mit kupplung fahren lernen vietnam
proposals.working_title: Schaltmotorrad mit Kupplung fahren lernen: Übungsplan vor der Vietnam-Tour
proposals.intent_rationale: German travellers who only hold a car licence or ride automatic scooters at home plan a northern Vietnam loop on a rented manual bike and look for a step-by-step way to learn clutch control before the trip.
proposals.content_angle: A practice plan in German for the clutch lever (Schleifpunkt, first-gear starts, up- and downshifts, hill starts), each step tied to stop-and-go Hanoi traffic and steep mountain passes where a stall is dangerous.

secondary_queries: nach einem bier roller fahren vietnam
proposals.working_title: Alkohol und Rollerfahren in Vietnam: Warum dort keine Promillegrenze gilt
proposals.intent_rationale: Germans used to a 0.5 per mille limit at home want to know whether one beer at dinner already makes riding a rented scooter in Vietnam illegal, and what a roadside breath test can lead to for a tourist.
proposals.content_angle: Explains Vietnam's zero-alcohol rule for every motor vehicle against the German limits, how breath checks and penalty tiers work under Decree 168/2024, why insurance cover is at stake, and practical evening plans without riding.

proposals.working_title: Tempolimits für Roller und Motorräder in Vietnam: innerorts, außerorts und auf Fernstraßen
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders planning longer stretches outside Hanoi want the actual numbers for motorbikes inside and outside built-up areas, because Vietnamese limits depend on road type and vehicle class rather than on simple signs as in Germany.
proposals.content_angle: Tabulates the speed limits for motorbikes and 50 cm³ mopeds under Circular 38/2024 by road type, explains why motorbikes stay off expressways, how speed cameras and penalties work, and how to read the local signs.

proposals.working_title: Vietnamesischen Motorradführerschein als Ausländer machen: Prüfung, Unterlagen und Ablauf
proposals.intent_rationale: Germans who move to Hanoi for work or a long stay, and who hold no motorcycle class at home, want to know whether and how they can sit the Vietnamese A1 test instead of relying on a German licence or an international permit.
proposals.content_angle: Walks through the Vietnamese A1 route for foreign residents: eligibility, documents, the theory and riding test, where to register and how long the licence is valid, clearly separated from using or converting a German licence.

secondary_queries: was deckt die pflichtversicherung in vietnam
proposals.working_title: Pflicht-Haftpflichtversicherung für Roller in Vietnam: Was sie deckt und was nicht
proposals.intent_rationale: Renters who assume a Vietnamese rental scooter is insured like a German vehicle want to know which compulsory cover exists, what it pays for after an accident and which document they must carry when stopped.
proposals.content_angle: Explains Vietnam's compulsory third-party liability insurance for motorbikes under Decree 67/2023 and what it does not cover (own injuries, the scooter), how to check the certificate at pick-up and how it differs from German Kfz-Haftpflicht and travel health cover.

proposals.working_title: Verkehrszeichen in Vietnam: Die wichtigsten Schilder für Rollerfahrer erklärt
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders who cannot read Vietnamese want to recognise the signs that change what a scooter may do, such as motorbike bans, lane assignments and turn restrictions, because many look different from the German catalogue.
proposals.content_angle: A sign-by-sign guide to the Vietnamese road signs that matter most on a scooter under QCVN 41:2024, grouped by the decision a rider must make, with notes on supplementary plates and the differences from German signs.

proposals.working_title: Rollerfahren in Hanoi im Winter: Kälte, Nieselregen und die richtige Ausrüstung
proposals.intent_rationale: Germans who travel in December to February expect tropical heat and are surprised by damp cold and drizzle in Hanoi; they want to know how riding conditions change and what to pack for the north.
proposals.content_angle: Covers the cool season in Hanoi and the northern mountains from a rider's view: humid cold, drizzle and slick roads, visibility, layering and gloves, and how cold spells affect day trips, distinct from the summer rainy season.

proposals.primary_query: was anziehen beim rollerfahren in vietnam
proposals.working_title: Was zieht man beim Rollerfahren in Vietnam an? Kleidung für Hitze, Regen und Sonne
proposals.intent_rationale: Travellers packing for a scooter trip want to balance protection against heat, sun and rain, and need concrete clothing advice that goes beyond the helmet rules covered elsewhere.
proposals.content_angle: A packing and wearing guide for riding in Vietnam's climate: abrasion-resistant layers, gloves and closed shoes, rain gear that is safe on a scooter, and sun protection, with what to buy locally versus bring from Germany.

proposals.working_title: Rollerdiebstahl in Hanoi vorbeugen: Parken, Schlösser und Gewohnheiten, die schützen
proposals.intent_rationale: Renters who are liable for the scooter during the rental want practical habits that keep the bike and their bags from being stolen in Hanoi, before anything goes wrong.
proposals.content_angle: Prevention-only guide: where and how to park, locks, keys and documents, phone and bag snatching from moving bikes, and night-time habits, deliberately separate from the question of who pays after a theft.

proposals.working_title: Roller parken in Hanoi: Bewachte Parkplätze, Parkschein und Verbote auf dem Gehweg
proposals.intent_rationale: Visitors riding into the Old Quarter or to sights want to know where a scooter may be left, how the paper-ticket parking works and what happens when a bike is parked on a pavement where it is not allowed.
proposals.content_angle: Explains Hanoi's parking practice for scooters: attended lots and tickets, official parking-fee rules, pavement restrictions and impounding, plus tips for sights, cafés and night markets.
